mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, increasing meloxicam plasma concentrations and NSAID-related adverse effects; meloxicam may increase erythromycin levels via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased meloxicam toxicity (GI bleeding, renal dysfunction, cardiovascular events); consider alternative antibiotic or reduce meloxicam dose if combination necessary.
